news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Phase 3 LEVEL Trial Missed Primary Endpoint in PH-HFpEF
news.summary: Tenax reported that oral levosimendan (TNX-103) improved 6-minute walk distance by 14 meters versus 10.4 meters for placebo, a difference that was not statistically significant, and also missed the key secondary KCCQ symptom-score endpoint. Safety was favorable and exploratory analyses showed a 49% reduction in NT-proBNP and a 3.5 mmHg placebo-adjusted drop in right ventricular systolic pressure, which the company is citing to support a patient-enrichment strategy going forward.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Shares Collapse Roughly 89-90% After Phase 3 Trial Failure
news.summary: TENX stock cratered from a prior close of $13.31 to around $1.36 after the LEVEL trial failed to hit statistical significance on its primary endpoint, wiping out most of the run-up that had built into the binary readout. The selloff reflects the market's view that the pre-specified subgroup and biomarker benefits are not enough on their own to support near-term FDA approval.

news.headline: William Blair Downgrades Tenax Therapeutics to Market Perform After LEVEL Miss
news.summary: William Blair cut its rating on TENX to Market Perform from Outperform following the disappointing Phase 3 LEVEL results, noting that while levosimendan showed consistent NT-proBNP and hemodynamic benefits likely to matter longer-term, the missed primary endpoint was clearly disappointing for the stock in the near term.

news.headline: Roth Capital Slashes Tenax Therapeutics Price Target to $5 from $30
news.summary: Roth Capital dramatically cut its price target on TENX to $5 from $30 in the wake of the failed LEVEL primary endpoint, joining a broader wave of sell-side target reductions as analysts reassessed the drug's regulatory path following the miss.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
news.summary: Tenax reported $118.0 million in cash and equivalents as of June 30, 2026, extending its runway through Q2 2028, while reaffirming that Phase 3 LEVEL topline data remained on track for August 2026. Net loss widened year-over-year to $17.8 million on higher trial-related spending.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity Initiates Coverage on Tenax Therapeutics with $35 Price Target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a $35 price target, the most bullish of a wave of sell-side initiations ahead of the August LEVEL data readout; the target was subsequently invalidated by the trial's primary-endpoint miss on August 10.

catalysts.label: ESC Congress 2026 late-breaking presentation of full LEVEL data
catalysts.detail: Complete Phase 3 LEVEL results (primary, secondary, and exploratory biomarker/subgroup analyses) to be presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology Congress in Munich, Germany (Congress runs August 28-31).

catalysts.label: FDA Type C meeting on LEVEL data and proposed enrichment strategy
catalysts.detail: Tenax intends to request a Type C meeting with the FDA to present the full LEVEL dataset and a proposed patient-enrichment strategy targeting the subgroup that showed a stronger treatment effect, leaning on the FDA's prior agreement that a single well-powered Phase 3 trial with p=0.01 could support an NDA submission.

catalysts.label: EMA scientific consultation on TNX-103 pathway
catalysts.detail: In parallel with the FDA discussions, Tenax plans to seek scientific consultation from the European Medicines Agency on a regulatory path forward for TNX-103 in PH-HFpEF.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly financial update, expected to include an update on FDA/EMA discussions, cash runway, and any revised trial or regulatory strategy following the LEVEL primary-endpoint miss.

pulse: Tenax's pivotal Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF missed its primary endpoint (6-minute walk distance) and key secondary endpoint on August 10, 2026, despite a favorable safety profile and encouraging NT-proBNP/hemodynamic and subgroup signals; TENX shares collapsed roughly 89-90% intraday (from about $13.31 to near $1.36) as William Blair downgraded the stock to Market Perform and Roth Capital cut its price target to $5 from $30. Management is now pursuing a Type C meeting with the FDA (plus parallel EMA scientific consultation) to discuss a patient-enrichment path toward NDA submission, with full LEVEL data due at a late-breaking ESC Congress session in Munich on August 29. The company still held about $118 million in cash as of June 30, 2026 (runway into Q2 2028), giving it time to regroup, but the investment thesis has shifted abruptly from binary-catalyst optionality to a slower regulatory-negotiation and cash-preservation story.
